array.string: # Check if it's Monday and between 9 AM and 11 AM, then run the pipeline DAY=$(date +%u) HOUR=$(date +%H) if [ "$DAY" = "1" ] && [ "$HOUR" -ge 9 ] && [ "$HOUR" -lt 11 ]; then # Check if we've already run today LAST_RUN_FILE="$HOME/Library/Logs/mumma_pipeline_last_run.txt" TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d) if [ ! -f "$LAST_RUN_FILE" ] || [ "$(cat "$LAST_RUN_FILE")" != "$TODAY" ]; then /Users/davidcraig/code/clove/MUMMA/Mumma_Pipeline/pipelines/mumma/run_mumma_pipeline.sh fi fi
